title: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) Structured Master's Scholarship - January 2027 intake (South African applicants)
official_source: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS), Muizenberg, Cape Town
program_type: Institute scholarship (fully funded postgraduate award from the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences)
duration: Structured Master's programme within AIMS's academic year, which "kicks off in September and runs through until the end of June"; the January intake begins in January and AIMS publishes no separate end date or programme length for it on this page
description: Portal VS lists the Applied Geosciences Bachelor's programme at the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, for academic year 2027/2028, in external combined form with a planned intake of 10 students. title: UNHCR Tertiary Refugee Scholarship Programme (DAFI) - Albert Einstein German Academic Refugee Initiative
official_source: UNHCR (funded by the Government of Germany, with support from the Governments of Denmark and the Czech Republic and private donors; implemented by UNHCR country operations and DAFI partners such as Windle International)
duration: Duration follows the degree programme enrolled in: ISCED 6 bachelor's or equivalent, or ISCED 5 short-cycle tertiary / TVET of two years or more
description: DAFI is UNHCR's dedicated tertiary scholarship programme for refugees and returnees, founded in 1992 and funded principally by the Government of Germany. title: Postgraduate Sanctuary Scholarship - University of Westminster
duration: Full-time master's course starting January 2027; maintenance grant of £1,000 per month for up to 12 months
description: The University of Westminster offers two Postgraduate Sanctuary Scholarships to students who are seeking asylum in the United Kingdom. Each covers full tuition costs for a full-time master's course starting January 2027, plus a maintenance grant of £1,000 per month for up to 12 months, published on the University's central scholarship listing as 'Full tuition fee plus up to £12,000'. Applications are made by returning the completed application form with required evidence as PDF attachments to scholarships@westminster.ac.uk by 5pm on Monday 2 November 2026.

title: Ernst Mach Grant – worldwide
official_source: OeAD-GmbH – Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
description: The Ernst Mach Grant – worldwide finances short research stays in Austria for young researchers from all disciplines and all countries except Austria. The published grant benefit is a supplementary monthly grant of EUR 1,300, together with assistance in arranging accommodation and health insurance, but scholarship holders pay the costs of accommodation and insurance themselves and must show own funds. Tuition fees at Austrian public universities and universities of applied sciences do not have to be paid by grant holders, and may be waived upon request to the rectorate, but this does not apply
